summary: KE Holdings Inc., a non-US private issuer, filed a Form 6-K comprising three Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Returns dated September 7, 9, and 11, 2026, under HK Listing Rule 13.25A. The filings disclose share repurchases on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange and NYSE, with 18 repurchase tranches detailed from May 22 to August 4, 2026. Prices range from HKD 36.0829 to HKD 45.0078 per share in Hong Kong and about USD 5.71 per share in the US, all repurchased for cancellation but not yet cancelled. No board recommendation or advisor is named. These are routine buyback disclosures, not a special situation, though the buyback pace warrants monitoring for capital return strategy.
